messages:
marta: kicking off an offsite VPC dry-run for ACME (apac-edge-2). goal: full air-gapped image seed + network validation by EOD. quick status?

sanjay: I ran the inventory — target cluster needs 12 GPUs (8 A10g + 4 T4) to hit perf SLOs. provisioning request queued, ETA 6h. cost est ~ $18k/mo for GPUs alone, FYI.

ian: noted. we also need to validate the upstream NAT and BGP config with customer — they block 0.0.0.0/0 egress except via proxy. will draft firewall rules.

marta: thanks. ACME wants airgap so no direct dockerhub. plan is: pull images in our staging, rsync to portable registry behind their NAT (s3 proxy), then run registry import on-site. outline below ->

marta: ```
# image seed flow (dry-run)
# 1. pull images -> staging-registry.redwood.internal
# 2. tar with docker save + gz
# 3. rsync --progress --checksum /staging/images tarball@acme-bastion:/data/seed/
# 4. on-site: registry-import --dir /data/seed/
```

deploy-bot: image-upload job completed against staging-registry (job id: img-seed-186345). 14 images, 28GB total. checksum OK. :white_check_mark:

acme-oncall: quick note — our edge team requires TCP 22, 443, 80, and 6443 for k8s controlplane, plus UDP 4500/500 for IPSEC VPN. will NOT open outbound 443 except to our proxy at 10.12.0.5:8443.

sanjay: acknowledged. update: keepalive for GPU nodes uses NTP to time servers; customer blocks outbound NTP — we can fallback to internal stratum on acme-land. need a step in handoff to configure chrony to point to 10.12.2.10.

ian: added to checklist. also validating kernel modules for MIG and nvidia driver: we should run this on the first boot:

ian: ```
modprobe nvidia_uci || true
/usr/bin/nvidia-smi -L || echo "drivers missing"
```

marta: good. for smoke validation we'll run a small generation job against a pinned model (gpt-small-v2-quant) to measure latency and kv-cache stability. acceptance criteria: median gen latency < 220ms for 256 tokens and no mem OOM on 80% load generator.

acme-oncall: we'll provide a /24 for service subnet and WG VPN certs. also need CA bundle for our registry import — posting to secure drop now.

opsbot: preflight check results: disk layout OK on 3 seed nodes, GPUs detected on 2/3 (node-03 missing drivers), network MTU inconsistent (9000 vs 1500) on node-02. See logs: /var/log/preflight-186345.log

marta: thanks opsbot. action items: (1) sanjay to reprovision node-03 drivers, (2) ian to normalize MTU to 9000 cluster-wide, (3) acme-oncall to confirm proxy ACL for 10.12.0.5:8443. I'll run the smoke job once ops items clear.

sanjay: started reprovision for node-03 now (kickstart + driver bundle). ETA 25m.

ian: changing MTU now via Ansible play: network/mtu-set -> rolling restart of CNI expected, we'll schedule at low-traffic window.

marta: once smoke passes, we'll do handoff: share runbook, jumpbox creds, registry CA, and an acceptance checklist. plan to schedule a 30min go/no-go call with ACME engineering at 1600 local. :calendar: 

acme-oncall: confirmed call time. will have network and security on the line. thanks for the dry-run update.

marta: closing loop — if anything blocks in the next 40m ping here. otherwise we'll promote this dry-run to a full customer handoff after the call and record the sign-off in the delivery ticket.
